buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Bidder has to quote the unit basic price inclusive of P&F, Freight, Insurance Charges, GST and any ot her charges 3. INSPECTION:Materials will be inspectedafter receipt at NTPC Stores. 4. Vendor has to provide HSN code and applicable GST rate which is included in the price of each item quote d.

5. Interchangeability: Vendor shall stand for interchangeability of the spares with the existing component s and for fitment into existing equipment without any mismatch. No separate Fitment/Interchangeability C ertificate is required to be submitted by the Supplier along with the material. The Fitment/Interchangeabili ty terms and conditions mentioned above shall be binding on the supplier. 6. Shelf Life: Cartridges manufacturing date should not be prior than the 6 months, when product is deliver ed at NTPC-Stores. Material should be Original from OEM- HP 7. The material supplied shall be new, genuine and shall be factory sealed inpackets of standard packing as per our specification. 8. During supply, NTPC may demand confirmation letter of Genuinity from OEM.Failing to submit the genuini ty confirmation letter from OEM within 07 days, will leadto rejection of Consignment (Cartridges). 9. Refilled / Reconditioned / Compatible Cartridges are NOT AT ALL Acceptable. 10.
